evidence.quote: In line with international practice for Bachelor's degree programmes, the programme can be completed in eight semesters.
Tuition fees for international students at universities in Baden-Württemberg are 1,500.00 EUR per semester.
International students are students who are not citizens of a member state of the European Union or another signatory state to the Agreement on the European Economic Area.

notes: Programme-specific deadlines: THU's Computer Science (CTS) page states an application period of 28 April - 15 July, but no year is given, so no intake date was output. The DAAD page states "This programme has no deadline listed." Tuition: the fee is a state-wide Baden-Württemberg figure of 1,500.00 EUR per semester for international students; no programme-specific fee was found, and exemptions may apply. Application channel: no evidence found for uni-assist or uni-assist VPD for this programme; the pages only state "Submit application via Please check this website." and direct applicants to the THU application portal, so applicationChannel was omitted.
